scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix api
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "CLIENT,API" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix api"
scripts.build:all: concurrently -n "CLIENT,API" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run build --prefix client" "npm run build --prefix api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix api
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
